title: Crestline Summit Club Entry Rules and Visit-Day Counting
content:
These rules govern entry to Summit Club locations under every membership of the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships range. The hour figures and the yes/no entitlements they refer to are set per membership.

## Entry rules

1. **Membership status.** A member enters only while the membership is active. This is read from the status recorded on that lounge membership itself before the visit.
2. **Same-day flight.** A member enters a club only with a boarding pass for a Crestline or partner flight departing the same day, no earlier than the membership's earliest-entry hours before that flight's scheduled departure, or during a connection when the membership permits entry during a connection.
3. **Disruption.** During a disruption, entry is allowed from the membership's disruption hours before the delayed flight's new departure.
4. **Basic Economy.** A member flying Crestline Basic Economy may not enter when the membership does not permit entry on Basic Economy.
5. **Arrival.** Entry on arrival from a Crestline flight requires a membership that includes entry on arrival.
6. **Partner and Reserve locations.** Partner airline lounges require a membership that includes partner lounge access, and Summit Club Reserve locations require a membership that includes Summit Club Reserve access.
7. **Amenities.** Shower suites and the spa credit follow the membership's shower-suite entitlement and its spa credit amount.

### Timing, illustrated (hypothetical figures: earliest entry 3 hours before departure; disruption entry 6 hours before the new departure)

| Situation | Entry |
|---|---|
| Flight departs today at 18:00; member arrives at the club at 14:30 | Not allowed — 3 and a half hours before departure is earlier than the 3-hour limit |
| Flight departs today at 18:00; member arrives at 15:00 | Allowed — exactly 3 hours before departure, which is not earlier than the limit |
| Flight delayed to a new departure at 21:00; member arrives at 15:00 during the disruption | Allowed — 6 hours before the new departure |
| Flight delayed to a new departure at 21:00; member arrives at 14:00 during the disruption | Not allowed — 7 hours before the new departure |
| Membership status is grace | Not allowed — the membership is not active |

## Visit allowance and extra-visit fees

Where the membership caps visits in a membership year:

- **Visit days.** The visit days of the current membership year are the distinct visit dates among the club visits recorded on that membership from the latest anniversary of its start date up to the handling date. Several entries on one calendar day count once when the membership counts same-day re-entry once.
- **Extra-visit fee.** Each visit day beyond the membership's included visit days carries the membership's extra-visit fee as its own charge — one charge per visit day.
- **New year.** The count starts again at each renewal when the membership's visit count resets on renewal.

### Counting, illustrated (hypothetical membership: visits capped; start date 10 February 2025; 4 included visit days; extra-visit fee 40 USD; same-day re-entry counted once)

| Club visits recorded in the membership year from 10 February 2025 | Visit days |
|---|---|
| 3 March (Denver), 3 March (Charlotte) | 1 — the same calendar day counts once |
| 20 April, 2 June, 30 July | 3 more, 4 in total |
| 14 September | the 5th visit day — beyond the 4 included, so it carries one extra-visit fee of 40 USD |
| 1 November, 1 November | the 6th visit day — one further extra-visit fee of 40 USD |

A visit on 12 February 2026 falls in the next membership year, which begins on the anniversary of the start date, 10 February 2026; the hypothetical membership resets its count on renewal, so that visit counts toward the new year's visit days and not toward the 6 of the earlier year.
